item.title: Orient match rearranged
item.description: Mansfield Town’s Sky Bet League One fixture away to Leyton Orient has been rearranged for Tuesday 14 April (7.45pm kick-off). The match, originally scheduled for Saturday 14 February, was postponed due to Stags’ progression in the Emirates FA Cup. Ticket details will be announced in due course.

item.description: Mansfield Town under-18s are aiming for three successive victories in the Youth Alliance League North on Saturday, as they go head-to-head with Burton Albion at RH Academy (11am kick-off). item.title: Stags sign new goalkeeper
item.description: Mansfield Town are delighted to announce the signing of experienced goalkeeper Harry Lewis from Carlisle United for an undisclosed fee. The 28-year-old has signed an 18-month contract at One Call Stadium. The 6ft 3in shot-stopper began his professional career at Southampton and made three Emirates FA Cup appearances for the Saints in 2017, keeping a clean sheet in a 1-0 third round replay win over Norwich City. item.title: Report: Stags 0-0 Wycombe
item.description: Mansfield Town extended their impressive unbeaten run to eight as they were forced to settle for a point in a goalless draw with Wycombe Wanderers at One Call Stadium. Chances were limited in a combative contest in Nottinghamshire, with neither side able to find a way past their opposite number meaning the game ended level.Manager Nigel Clough made three alterations from the side that battled to a draw with Plymouth Argyle in midweek.
